task_completion.description: Open the Event Rules management window in the Nx Witness client.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or window titled 'Event Rules' is visible over the main application interface.

task_completion.description: Select 'Soft Trigger' as the event type for the new rule.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Event Rule settings, the 'Event' dropdown or type is set to 'Soft Trigger'.

task_completion.description: Set the trigger button name to 'Flag Suspect' and assign it to the 'Entrance Camera'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' or 'Caption' field for the Soft Trigger contains the text 'Flag Suspect', and the 'At' or 'Source' field shows 'Entrance Camera' selected.
In the 'Action' section of the rule, the 'Do' dropdown is set to 'Create Bookmark'.

task_completion.description: Set the bookmark name to 'Suspicious Activity' and target the 'Entrance Camera'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The bookmark configuration fields show the text 'Suspicious Activity' and the target device is 'Entrance Camera'.

task_completion.description: Configure the bookmark duration to a fixed 30 seconds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The duration setting for the bookmark action is set to 'Fixed' or a specific value of '30s' or '00:00:30'.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface to configure the rule rather than scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Nx Witness desktop client menus and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to send API requests to the VMS server.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is either not used or only used for non-configuration tasks; the configuration is clearly performed within the Event Rules GUI.

integrity.description: The agent typed the required strings into the application fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text 'Flag Suspect' and 'Suspicious Activity' appear in the appropriate GUI text boxes during the configuration process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target camera is 'Entrance Camera'. The soft trigger button must be named 'Flag Suspect'. The resulting action must be a bookmark titled 'Suspicious Activity'. The duration must be exactly 30 seconds. All configurations must be applied within the Nx Witness Event Rules engine.
